async def act(page):
    # Open the Sales menu by clicking it
    await page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name=" Sales").click()
    # Wait briefly for menu to open
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click Orders link to navigate to Orders page
    await page.get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("link", name="Orders").click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Wait for page to load fully
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    # Find the table with orders (assuming role "table")
    table = page.get_by_role("table")
    # Get all rows in the table body (assuming role "row" under "rowgroup")
    rows = table.get_by_role("rowgroup").get_by_role("row")
    pending_rows = []
    row_count = await rows.count()
    for i in range(row_count):
        row = rows.nth(i)
        # Get all cells in the row (assuming role "cell")
        cells = row.get_by_role("cell")
        cell_count = await cells.count()
        for j in range(cell_count):
            cell = cells.nth(j)
            cell_text = await cell.text_content()
            if cell_text and 'Pending' in cell_text:
                pending_rows.append(row)
                break
    if not pending_rows:
        return "No pending orders found."
    # Assume newest pending order is the first in the list
    newest_row = pending_rows[0]
    # Get the first cell of the row (likely containing order ID)
    order_id_cell = newest_row.get_by_role("cell").first
    order_id = await order_id_cell.text_content()
    return order_id.strip()
